field.notes: First downs by crossing zone lines, NOT by gaining 10 yards

players.must_play_rule: All players must play half the game. Each half: player is on offense OR defense for the entire half. Sideline must clear on every change of possession.

game_length.clock: Running clock for all of 1st half and first 18 min of 2nd half. Last 2 min of 2nd half = NIRSA timing (NCAA-style stoppages).

scoring.notes: After TD, offense chooses 1pt (5yd), 2pt (10yd), or 3pt (20yd). Once ball is set, can only change with timeout.

downs.short_rush: If offense is within 5 yards of first down or goal line, defense lines up just behind the line

kicking.kickoffs: NONE - start at 30-yard line after scores and half starts
kicking.punts: Declared punt = ball moved 30 yards from LOS. Inside opponent 40 = half the distance. Ultimate division punt = 15 yards.

rushing.screening_illegal: Offensive player cannot impede rusher. Rusher has right to clear path to QB.
rushing.exception: If offensive player does NOT move after snap, rusher must go around them

ball_rules.backward_passes: Can be caught or intercepted and advanced. Dead if touches ground.
ball_rules.forward_passes: Only ONE forward pass per play

flag_rules.shirts_tucked: Must be tucked, cannot cover flags
flag_rules.illegal_securing: If belt illegally secured: score disallowed, player ejected, 10-yard unsportsmanlike penalty
flag_rules.flag_guard: Illegal - swinging arm over flags, placing ball over flags, lowering head/shoulders
flag_rules.deflag_before_touch: Illegal to pull flag before player has touched ball

personal_fouls.no_diving: Cannot intentionally dive to gain yardage
personal_fouls.no_stripping: Cannot strip, steal, or attempt to steal ball
personal_fouls.roughing_the_passer: Any contact to QB above waist outside of flag pull = automatic first down + penalty yards

special_rules.ball_extension: When flag pulled, ball spotted at forward-most point of football
special_rules.onside_conversion: If trailing and score with <2 min left, still trailing by 9 or fewer: 1 play from own 20 to cross 40-yard line to retain possession
special_rules.mercy_rule: If ahead by 19+ at 2-minute warning of 2nd half, game is over
special_rules.overtime_regular_season: Each team gets 1 play from 5 or 10-yard line. Score from 5=1pt, from 10=2pts. If 1st team scores, 2nd must go for 2. Can end in tie.

equipment.no_pockets: Shorts/pants cannot have pockets, belt loops, or exposed strings. Tape over pockets does NOT make legal.
equipment.no_towels: If towel pulled during play, counted as flag pull
equipment.cleats: No metal/ceramic/screw-in except if screw is part of cleat
equipment.eyeglasses: Must be clear sports glasses with prescription. No metal, no sunglasses.
